scope: bounded selected metadata and normal RGB555 pixels only

visualReview.method: Actual model inspection of freshly independently decoded contact images via view_image; 2x nearest display, original logical origin retained
observations: Each sampled direction has a coherent standing/bending/recovering pose sequence; no visible tile seams, missing strips or header clipping in samples.
Gfx2796 labels preserve pickup frame1/2/3 on sid48..55 rather than shifting to0/1/2.
Aliases61->3213,48->3215,1186->3221 and non-alias2796/6650 retain separate directional raw entries; no mirrored substitutes.
Red cross is logical origin and can sit away from feet; original signed bounds are not a foot-pivot claim.
Transparent surroundings and dark opaque body details remain visible; 6752 black pixels are established numerically, not counted visually.
visualReview.sourceSemanticQualification: sampled visual plausibility only, not native playback/timing or release provenance
